```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(if (file.exists("../R/paths.R")) "../R/paths.R" else "R/paths.R")

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)

dir.create("./Results/Figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
Seasons_tags <- read.csv(coastal_data_file("r", "Calculations", "Seasons_tags.csv"), sep = ";")
```

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=20}
Environmental_and_genes_ratios <- read.csv(  coastal_data_file("r", "Calculations", "Para_Sandra_Environmental_and_genes_ratios_2026_SMG.csv"), sep = ";") %>%
    dplyr::select(1,8,24)%>%
    separate(sample, c( "Season", "day", "Station"), sep="_", remove=T)  %>%
    unite(sample, Season, Station, day, sep="_", remove=T) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(Seasons_tags, by="sample") %>%
      separate(sample, c( "Season", "day", "Station"), sep="_", remove=T) %>%
        separate(Season_Station, c( "Season", "Station"), sep="/", remove=T)  %>%
mutate(day = gsub("D", "", day))
```


```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}

ratio_plot <- ggplot(Environmental_and_genes_ratios, aes(y=pstS, x=PO4)) +
  geom_point (size=4, alpha = 0.4,col = "orange3") +
  ggtitle("pstS vs PO₄")+
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=T) + # Agregar línea de tendencia
  labs(x="PO₄ ratio", y="pstS ratio", fill="", col="") +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, colour = "black")) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))+
    theme(plot.subtitle  = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, size=16)) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, size=16)) +
    theme(strip.text=element_text(size=16))+
    theme(strip.text.x=element_text(size=16 , angle=0 ,face="bold"),
          strip.text.y=element_text(size=16 , angle=0 ,face="bold") ,
          strip.background =
        element_rect(colour="black" ,fill="white")) +
    theme(legend.position="top",
          axis.title=element_text(hjust = 0.5, size=22))


# Calcular R cuadrado
model <- lm(pstS ~ PO4, data = Environmental_and_genes_ratios)
r_squared <- summary(model)$r.squared

ratio_plot

ratio_plot
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# 1) Modelo lineal
fit <- lm(pstS ~ PO4, data = Environmental_and_genes_ratios)
sumfit <- summary(fit)

r2 <- sumfit$r.squared
pval <- sumfit$coefficients["PO4", "Pr(>|t|)"]

# (opcional) formateo bonito
lab <- sprintf("R² = %.3f\np = %.2g", r2, pval)

# 2) Tu plot + anotación
ratio_plot <- ggplot(Environmental_and_genes_ratios, aes(y = pstS, x = PO4)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.4, col = "orange3") +
  ggtitle("pstS vs PO₄") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "PO₄ ratio", y = "pstS ratio", fill = "", col = "") +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, colour = "black")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 16)) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 16)) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 16)) +
  theme(
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16, angle = 0, face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 16, angle = 0, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = "white")
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", axis.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 22)) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = lab,
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 5)

ratio_plot

```


```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=20}
Environmental_and_genes_ratios_long <- pivot_longer(Environmental_and_genes_ratios, cols=2:3, names_to = "Metadata", values_to = "Value") #Vanessa Dataset


Environmental_and_genes_ratios_long$Station  <- factor(Environmental_and_genes_ratios_long$Station,
                                           levels = c("Offshore", "Coast"))

Environmental_and_genes_ratios_long$Metadata <- factor(Environmental_and_genes_ratios_long$Metadata,
                                                  levels = c("PO4", "pstS"),
                                                  labels = c("PO₄\nratio", "pstS\nratio"))


Environmental_and_genes_ratios_long$Season <- factor(Environmental_and_genes_ratios_long$Season,
                                              levels = c("Winter",
                                                         "Spring",
                                                         "Summer"),
                                              labels = c("WIN",
                                                         "SPG",
                                                         "SUM"))


Phosphorus_metabolism_ratio_plot <- ggplot(Environmental_and_genes_ratios_long, aes(
  x=Value, y=day, size=1,fill =Value )) + # colour=mean_tpm,
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.2) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.4, shape = 21) +
  ggtitle("") +
  labs(x="Ratio = daily value / average of 4 days", y="Time (days)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))+
    theme(plot.subtitle  = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, size=16)) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size=16)) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 18)) +
    theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size=18, angle=0, face="bold"),
          strip.text.y = element_text(size=18, angle=0, face="bold"),
          strip.background = element_rect(colour="black", fill="white"),
        axis.title=element_text(hjust = 0.45, size=18)) +
    theme(legend.position="none") +
scale_fill_viridis(option="turbo", direction = 1) +

    facet_nested(Metadata ~ Station+Season,
                  scales = "free", strip = strip_nested(size = "variable"))+
      guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=8)))+

 coord_flip()

Phosphorus_metabolism_ratio_plot

ggsave("./Results/Figures/NP_pstS_1.png",
         width = 20, # anchura
         height = 12, # altur2
         units = "cm",
         dpi = 600)
```
